justification: Changes pagination strategy for production ingest script. Touches DB queries and API calls. No frontend changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: nsw_cadastre_lots table (2.5M rows). UPSERT on lotidstring — safe for re-runs.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If objectid column missing in DB, get_max_objectid() fails with SQL error (visible).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to new rows only when --resume. Full re-ingest without --resume still works.

functions.name: get_max_objectid
functions.input: conn — active psycopg2 database connection object

functions.name: fetch_page
functions.input: where clause string with objectid cursor
functions.output: dict with features list from Esri JSON response
functions.if_none: Returns {features: []} — loop terminates after 3 empty pages

values.nullable: no — objectid always present in Esri response
values.if_missing: Uses 0, cursor doesn't advance, empty_streak hits 3, loop exits

queries.purpose: Get max objectid for resume cursor
queries.if_zero: COALESCE returns 0 — full ingest from start
queries.if_wrong: Would skip lots with lower objectid — but objectid is monotonic

queries.if_zero: Prints 0 remaining, loop exits on first empty page
queries.if_wrong: Only affects ETA display, not data correctness

break_it.scenario: FeatureServer doesn't support orderByFields on objectid
break_it.what_happens: Pages return in arbitrary order, cursor advances past some lots, gaps in data
break_it.how: Tested: API returns ordered results with objectid ASC. UPSERT means re-runs fill gaps.
break_it.repro: Run with --limit 5000 --resume, verify objectid range is contiguous

break_it.scenario: objectid has gaps (non-contiguous), cursor skips valid lots
break_it.what_happens: No impact — cursor uses > not =, so gaps are irrelevant
break_it.how: WHERE objectid > X returns next batch regardless of gaps
break_it.repro: Check DB: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT objectid) vs MAX(objectid)-MIN(objectid)

break_it.scenario: DB connection drops mid-ingest (Supabase IO budget)
break_it.what_happens: Retry loop reconnects (5 attempts, 30s*n backoff). If all fail, raises.
break_it.repro: Run during known IO budget exhaustion window

post_merge.manual_verify: Run --scope all --resume --limit 5000 and verify rows increase
